principle: Every comparison is against a route that exists in the same road graph and satisfies the same distance band, so the only difference between the selected route and the baseline is the ranking objective.

baselines.name: shortest_path
baselines.definition: Minimum-length route in the same OSM graph for the same start/end and target distance, ignoring every environment and preference term.
baselines.role: primary comparison for detour and environment win rate

baselines.name: first_candidate
baselines.definition: The first geometrically valid candidate emitted by the generator before ranking.
baselines.role: isolates the contribution of the ranking step

baselines.name: random_candidate
baselines.definition: A candidate drawn with random.Random(1234) from the valid pool.

baselines.name: environment_only
baselines.definition: Ranking on the environment proxy alone, with preference and access weights set to zero.
baselines.role: ablation of the preference and access dimensions

baselines.name: round1_reported
baselines.definition: The round-1 reported values (detour_pass_rate 0.00, environment_win_rate 0.00, preference_win_rate 0.50, constraint_pass_rate 0.00, fatal_data_errors 1, no_candidate 18/45).
baselines.role: historical reference; read from allowed round-1 diagnostics only, never re-executed

pairing_rule: Within a cell, B0 is computed for the same start node and target distance as the selected route; B1/B2/B3 are drawn from the same valid candidate pool.
statistical_plan: Per-cell pass/fail plus a route-level bootstrap at 95% confidence with seed 1234 for win-rate intervals. No significance claim is made about health outcomes.
known_limitation: M1 cannot be re-executed because round-1 generated source is on the isolated list; it is quoted as reported.
